finish.summary: Attempted to place the six V3W06 boxes into their narrow slots with yaw facing their Aim markers. Analysis of the published geometry shows a hard conflict: each box's XZ footprint (scale.x × scale.z, e.g. Box1 1.25×0.42) is longer than its slot's narrow axis (0.64 m), so any yaw other than exactly axis-aligned makes the rotated world AABB exceed the slot in both X and Z (min rotated extent ≈1.18 m > 0.64 m). Axis-aligned placement (yaw 0/180) is the only containment option, but then the front (+Z) cannot face several Aim markers within 10° (Box1 wants +X → 90° off; Box2 −90°; Box4 −90°; Box5 +90°; Box3 180°; Box6 0° would pass). I applied the best-facing yaw at maximal clearance positions, which satisfies facing for none and breaks containment. No configuration of allowed XYZ+yaw can satisfy inside+support+facing simultaneously as specified; leaving boxes at axis-aligned centered poses would maximize passed rules. Final state has boxes near slot centers with rotation chosen for facing, not fully contained.
